ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central and lower regions versus 40% high-intensity (white) pixels localized on the distal lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern consisting of saw-tooth peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge, with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5 and 20 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex-curved trajectory extending from the median notch to the distal tips, exhibiting a symmetrical upward and outward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned vertical and diagonal high-contrast white linear disruptions (rake marks) visible across the lower-central black pigment and within the distal white patches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy colonization of calcified acorn barnacles forming dense, high-relief clusters on the terminal tips and trailing edges of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent dark circular pixel cluster isolated within the high-intensity white region of the left lobe's outer edge.
